# `github.com/grow-codes-packages/openbao/go` — agent quickstart (Go)

Ships in the module root (`go env GOMODCACHE`/github.com/grow-codes-packages/openbao/go@vX/AGENTS.md). Use it
instead of reading the source. Docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/openbao/ · Service: OpenBao ·
Categories: secrets. Package name: `openbao`. Needs Go >= 1.26 (`GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` on older images).

```sh
go get github.com/grow-codes-packages/openbao/go@latest
```

## Client

```go
import openbao "github.com/grow-codes-packages/openbao/go"

client, err := openbao.NewClientFromEnv() // GROW_OPENBAO_* > vendor env > defaults
defer client.Close()
```

Errors are `*openbao.Error` with `Code`; use `errors.Is(err, openbao.ErrNotFound)` (`ErrConfig`, `ErrAuthentication`,
`ErrPermissionDenied`, `ErrConflict`, `ErrRateLimited`, `ErrValidation`, `ErrUnavailable`, `ErrTimeout`,
`ErrUnsupported`, `ErrCancelled`). Credentials are `Secret` (redacted in fmt/slog/JSON).

## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```go
values, err := openbao.LoadConfig(ctx, openbao.LoadOptions{Required: []string{"DATABASE_URL"}, IntoEnv: true})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } // NOT_FOUND names the missing keys
```

- `LoadConfig(ctx context.Context, opts LoadOptions) (map[string]string, error)`;
  `LoadOptions{Required []string; IntoEnv bool; KeepExisting bool; Path string; Env map[string]string; Connect SecretsConnector}`
  (`IntoEnv` → `os.Setenv`; set it, the zero value only returns the map).
- Reads the platform bootstrap `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `openbao`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`, `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH=approle` + `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`_SECRET_ID`
  (AppRole login), then every key under `GROW_SECRETS_PATH` (never `GROW_SECRETS_*` into the env).
- No bootstrap (local dev) → checks `Required` against the environment only. `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1`
  (grow-secrets-exec) → same, returns the required keys.
- Also: `LoadConfigFrom(ctx, provider, opts)`, `ReadSecretsBootstrap(env)`, `SecretsPreloaded(env)`, `PackageKey`.
